drc_salb_2018_2024.method: Name and Atlas parent string candidate screen only. The 2019 OCHA source has no matching SALB code; no source ID, geometries, or boundaries were compared. Moanda/Muanda is ambiguous between two same-parent current units.
drc_salb_2018_2024.limits: SALB geometry was not requested or retained. This non-commercial comparator is not a source for live production geometry or a completeness certificate.
